items.title: Anthropic's Claude Cowork heads to the cloud as data shows 90% of sessions aren't for coding
items.summary: Claude Cowork is moving to web and mobile, and new data shows it's being used far beyond coding and software development. Can it safely replace OpenClaw for me? Stay tuned.
items.titleZh: Anthropic的Claude Cowork前往云端，因为数据显示90%的会话不是用于编码的
items.summaryZh: Claude Cowork正在转向网络和移动，新的数据显示，它的使用范围远远超出了编码和软件开发。它能安全地取代OpenClaw吗？敬请期待。

items.title: Shut Those Laptops! Anthropic Puts Its Claude Cowork Agent on Your Phone
items.summary: Claude Cowork now keeps working on tasks even after you close your laptop. It’s part of a larger push toward smartphone-controlled agents.
items.titleZh: 把那些笔记本电脑关上！Anthropic将其Claude Cowork代理放在您的手机上
items.summaryZh: Claude Cowork现在即使在你关闭笔记本电脑后也能继续处理任务。这是向智能手机控制的代理商迈进的一部分。

items.title: He went from working in a factory to being rich enough to retire at 32—but 3 decades later, this millionaire still works and takes public transport
items.summary: Bill Holland, who led Canada's CI Financial for more than a decade, still rides public transit—a frugal mantra shared by Warren Buffett and Elon Musk.
items.titleZh: 他从工厂工作到32岁退休，但30年后，这位百万富翁仍然工作，乘坐公共交通工具
items.summaryZh: 比尔·霍兰德（Bill Holland）领导加拿大CI金融公司十多年，他仍然乘坐公共交通——这是沃伦·巴菲特（Warren Buffett）和埃隆·马斯克（Elon Musk）共同的节俭口号。

items.title: 'Utterly inconceivable': Investing legend Jeremy Grantham says there's a 90% chance SpaceX stock will crash
items.summary: Jeremy Grantham said there's a 90% chance SpaceX stock will crash, pointing to concerns about its valuation and planned space projects.
items.titleZh: “完全不可思议”：投资传奇人物Jeremy Grantham表示，SpaceX的股票有90%的可能性会崩盘
items.summaryZh: Jeremy Grantham表示，SpaceX的股票有90%的可能性会崩盘，并指出对其估值和计划中的太空项目的担忧。
